title: Anchor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- Shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='8' height='44' rx='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- Crossbar -->
  <rect x='28' y='30' width='44' height='8' rx='4' fill='#EF476F'/>
  <!-- Flukes (arms curving up) -->
  <path d='M30 64 Q20 64 20 52 L20 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 64 Q80 64 80 52 L80 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Arrow tips on flukes -->
  <path d='M14 46 L20 36 L26 46 Z' fill='#EF476F'/>
  <path d='M74 46 L80 36 L86 46 Z' fill='#EF476F'/>
  <!-- Bottom curve of anchor -->
  <path d='M30 64 Q50 80 70 64' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on shank -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#06D6A0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#06D6A0'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 46 Q50 53 57 46' fill='none' stroke='#06D6A0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FF9F1C' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FF9F1C' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
